data.title: Vista
data.about:
Vista at Dubai Sports City is a newly launched residential development by Prestige One Developments with studios, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments. The development offers a huge collection of luxury apartments for the people of Dubai to set their standard of high and qualitatively living. Begin a new journey of your life by becoming a part of this latest development and its green and cool environment that keeps you fresh and calm.

Living with luxury is possible here at this development, designed by renowned architectural connoisseurs LACASA and offers exclusive golf views. The façade pays homage to the modern luxury inherent in the building character that flows in the luxury interiors and exteriors. The development comprises all the necessary services and top-class facilities for its residents just to not let them wander anywhere for anything.

By becoming a member of the community, this new development is an excellent opportunity to get your dream home. A balanced urban lifestyle can be enjoyed by the residents by engaging themselves in the comprehensive amenities of the community.
